description: This file contains transformation logic for converting Cohere's rerank API response format to Infinity's format, including URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation.

classes.name: InfinityRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Infinity rerank API, extending CohereRerankConfig with methods for URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for the Infinity rerank service, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and validates headers and environment variables for API requests, including API key retrieval.

methods.name: transform_rerank_response
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response from Infinity's rerank API into the standardized RerankResponse format, including error handling and metadata extraction.
